notes: The chain šəbî hag-gôlāh is read under rule 29's fronting clause: the article s010 takes the single *the* the ASV writes and s009 takes only *captivity*; the rule 41 alternative is recorded in the s011 note.
bənēy hammədînāh is the arthrous case of rule 29 — two *the*s, one before each word — so the article takes t007 and the construct a supplied t004.
s020's supplied relativizer *that* is kept with the verb it introduces; the apodosis-waw alternative is recorded there and does not apply outside a hāyāh frame (rule 45).
